message: PctChrome (libs/components/widget/src/chrome.ts) writes a `host` block this read does not take as written
$reason: `host-entry-by-shorthand` with the entry inside an object spread where it is written: an entry the read does not take as written is refused wherever the spread puts it, and a read that took the spread's other entries and passed over that one would stand the host with a name and no role.
